title: TripSplit - Expense Splitting Made Easy (And Less Awkward)

sections.title: Group Trips Without the 'Who Owes What?' Drama
sections.description:
Splitting expenses in a group trip usually goes one of two ways: a meticulous accountant tracking every cent or utter chaos where everyone forgets who paid what. 🤯

TripSplit fixes this by making expense tracking effortless. Here’s how:

  • Users sign up via email authentication (handled securely using Firebase).
  • After signing up, users can:
    • Create a new trip by entering a title and selecting up to three currencies.
    • Join an existing trip using a unique 6-character trip ID.
    • View their existing trips and manage expenses seamlessly.

With TripSplit, you can finally focus on enjoying your trip instead of figuring out who still owes for last night’s dinner. 🍕💰

sections.title: Adding Expenses - No More Confusion Over Currency Conversions
sections.description:
Ever struggled with splitting bills when dealing with multiple currencies? TripSplit has you covered. 🌍💸

  • When adding a new expense, users enter:
    • Date 📅
    • Description 📝
    • Amount (entered in one currency, auto-converted to the other chosen currencies using real-time exchange rates from an open-source API) 💱
    • Expense Split (must add up to the total expense amount)
  • Want to track personal expenses separately? Just check the 'Self-Expense' option—these expenses won’t be split with other users.

By handling real-time currency conversions and ensuring every split balances correctly, TripSplit makes expense tracking ridiculously simple. 🔥

sections.title: Viewing Balances & Settling Up
sections.description:
Instead of arguing over who owes whom, TripSplit calculates it all for you. 📊

  • Users can view:
    • Balances: Who owes whom and how much to settle expenses.
    • Total Self-Expenses: Your personal expenses that weren’t split.
    • Real-time currency rates to avoid bad exchange rate calculations.

This means no more awkward money conversations at the end of the trip—just simple, clear numbers. 🏆

sections.title: Managing Trip Members - Adding, Accepting, and Removing Users
sections.description:
Trips often involve last-minute changes—people join, leave, or change plans. TripSplit makes managing members hassle-free. 👥

  • Users can send trip join requests, which existing members can accept.
  • If someone isn’t part of any expenses, they can be removed from the trip.
  • Trips can be renamed or deleted (only if there are no expenses attached).

This ensures only the right people are in your trip, without cluttering the expense records. 🚀

sections.title: Technical Details - The Magic Behind the Scenes
sections.description:
TripSplit is built for speed, security, and simplicity, using a solid tech stack. ⚙️

  • Backend: Flask (Python) with SQLAlchemy ORM.
  • Frontend: React (responsive, smooth UI built from scratch 🎨).
  • Authentication: Firebase for email-based authentication.
  • Database: MySQL, optimized for handling group expenses efficiently.
  • Deployment: Hosted on a Linux server with Nginx, running on a custom domain.

With TripSplit, you don’t just manage expenses—you eliminate trip finance stress. 🎉
